newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot to carry salmon Norway-Japan.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot to carry salmon Norway-Japan.

text.p: Russian international carrier Aeroflot plans to fly fresh salmon from Norway to Japan, an official at the company cargo department said on Friday.
"We are close to signing a contract to make three flights from Norway to Nagoya and one flight to Tokyo to carry fresh salmon," the official said.
Aeroflot's press service said the company would make four weekly cargo flights between Moscow and Tokyo and three flights a week between Moscow and Nagoya in its summer schedule.
Both routes will be operated by DC-10-30 and Ilyushin Il-76 cargo planes, the service said.

Aeroflot also hopes to increase passenger volume on its Moscow-Japan regular flights this year. The press service said the company carried 95,000 passengers between Russia and Japan last year, compared with 71,000 passengers in 1992.
